evals.name: registration-rule
evals.prompt: Reject empty author names on registration. Show where the rule goes.
assertions: Applies NotEmpty to Name with the member error Name is required.

evals.name: discovery
evals.prompt: Should I register the author validator in DI and throw from Handle too?
assertions: Explains that Arc discovers the command validator.
Does not duplicate the rule in Handle.
Keeps other registration-specific rules on the same validator.

evals.name: outcome
evals.prompt: Test empty and valid names through the registration pipeline.
assertions: Checks IsValid and IsSuccess false for empty input.
Checks the member in ValidationResults and no append.
Checks registration succeeds once for Aster.
